main.summary: Persists provider-neutral transfer metadata in the DataControl PostgreSQL database.

field.name: contexts
field.summary: Factory used to create DataControl database contexts.

method.name: LoadSessionsCoreAsync
method.summary: Applies indexed filters and an optional catalog restriction before materializing session state.
method.param: Required catalog restriction for tenant-scoped queries, or null for authorized admin inventory.

method.name: LoadStaleTransferSessionCandidatesAsync
method.summary: Loads a bounded cursor page of sessions owned by the specified catalog whose last server-observed activity is at or before a fixed cleanup cutoff.
method.param: Authorized catalog that must own the candidates.
Inclusive activity cutoff for this scan.
Exclusive cursor from the preceding page, or null for the first page.
Maximum number of lightweight candidates to return.

method.name: HasDependentSessionAsync
method.summary: Checks for any catalog-scoped staged-read or stream-follow dependent before removing a source session, including stale dependents that may be cleaned later in the scan.
method.param: Authorized catalog restriction for the dependent lookup.
method.returns: True when a dependent prevents source cleanup.

method.name: HasPublicationJournalAsync
method.summary: Checks whether a catalog-scoped publication journal exists for a transfer session.
method.param: Authorized catalog restriction for the journal lookup.
method.returns: True when the journal must protect the session from explicit closure.

method.name: TouchTransferSessionAsync
method.summary: Advances the server-observed activity timestamp for one catalog and item-scoped session without changing its manifest or transfer state version.
method.param: Authorized catalog that must own the session.
method.returns: True when the matching session was touched.

method.name: LoadJournalsForInstanceAsync
method.summary: Loads journal states belonging to the exact catalog, item, and item instance token.
method.returns: Matching journals ordered by session identifier.

method.name: DeleteJournalsForInstanceAsync
method.summary: Deletes journal rows belonging to the exact catalog, item, and item instance token.
method.returns: True when one or more journals were deleted.

method.name: LoadStreamChunkAsync
method.summary: Loads one stream chunk by offset through its catalog-owned parent session.
method.returns: The matching stream chunk, or null.

method.name: PromoteStagedReadSessionAsync
method.summary: Conditionally promotes an existing segmented staged-read follow row to published-read state when its source session and item instance token match.
method.param: Authorized catalog name that must own the row.
method.returns: True when the row matched the required identity and staged-read mode.

constructor.name: PostgresTransferStateStore
constructor.summary: Initializes a PostgreSQL transfer state store.
constructor.param: Factory used to create DataControl database contexts.

method.name: ApplySessionState
method.summary: Copies provider-neutral session state into its PostgreSQL row.

method.name: ApplyJournalState
method.summary: Copies provider-neutral publication journal state into its PostgreSQL row.

method.name: GetManifestProjection
method.summary: Extracts and validates the catalog, item instance token, and source-session projection from a serialized transfer manifest.
method.param: Transfer session state containing the serialized manifest.
method.returns: The catalog name and optional source session identifier projected from the manifest.

method.name: ToSessionState
method.summary: Converts a PostgreSQL session row into provider-neutral session state.

method.name: CommitSegmentedRangeAsync
method.summary: Atomically commits a verified segmented range and its updated session manifest only when the persisted session and manifest item instance tokens match, while accepting identical retries.
method.param: Verified range to persist or compare.
Session state with the proposed range coverage and version.
Session version on which the write was based.
Authorized catalog name that must own the parent session.
method.returns: Committed, replayed, or rejected range result with authoritative version.

method.name: ToSegmentedRangeState
method.summary: Converts a PostgreSQL segmented-range row into provider-neutral range state.

method.name: ToStreamChunkState
method.summary: Converts a PostgreSQL stream-chunk row into provider-neutral chunk state.

method.name: ToJournalState
method.summary: Converts a PostgreSQL publication-journal row into provider-neutral journal state.

method.name: ToJournalIntegrity
method.summary: Reconstructs the compact journal integrity summary from its PostgreSQL columns.
method.param: Publication journal row containing the integrity columns.
method.returns: The reconstructed integrity summary, or null when its required values are incomplete.

method.name: ToBlob
method.summary: Builds a Blob reference when all persisted Blob metadata is present.
method.returns: The Blob reference, or null when required metadata is absent.

method.name: ValidateRange
method.summary: Validates a non-empty transfer range and its immutable Blob payload metadata.

method.name: ValidatePayload
method.summary: Validates the required name, length, and SHA-512 metadata for an immutable Blob payload.

method.name: EnsureSamePayload
method.summary: Ensures a retry presents the same immutable Blob metadata as an existing record.
method.param: Payload kind used in the conflict message.
